Report only what the posting states. Use not_stated freely. Every extracted or uncertain fact must cite verbatim posting evidence. Source wording and evidence stay verbatim in the posting's language: do not change capitalization, reword, invent minimums, or impose caps. Lists may be empty.

Section headings determine required versus preferred qualifications. Treat an unlabeled requirements list as required unless an item says preferred, a plus, nice to have, ideally, or bonus. Duties mixed into requirements are responsibilities only when phrased as an action the person will perform.

For experience level, title words outrank years. Map 0 to 1 years to entry, 1 to 3 to junior, 3 to 5 to mid, and 5 or more to senior. Use lead, principal, or executive only from role words. Infer work mode only from explicit wording; a city alone means not_stated. Job functions may contain multiple categories. Data science and machine learning belong under Data & Analytics; Technology & Engineering covers software, infrastructure, security, QA, and architecture.

Extract every named language, framework, platform, database, cloud service, or tool anywhere in the posting and cite the sentence containing it. Assign required or preferred from the section; use mentioned when it appears only in duties or company text. Preserve the source mention exactly and do not normalize technology names.

Write the summary in English as exactly two factual sentences without marketing adjectives. All other extracted source wording remains verbatim in its source language. Return failed for no field; failed is reserved for deterministic validation.
